Near the airport and Easton Town Center

Located minutes from Easton Town Center, we’re three miles to the Columbus Airport and 10 minutes to Downtown. Shopping, dining, and businesses are all nearby. Our suites feature a kitchen and separate living and working areas. Enjoy our indoor heated saline pool or gather outside by our fire pit. Breakfast and WiFi are complimentary.
